appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.darkModeDescription: Use the dark theme across the app.

folders.title: Data folders
folders.description: Where Story Forge keeps profiles and game versions. Defaults to the app data directory.
folders.useAppDirectoryDescription: Store profiles and versions inside Story Forge's own folder.
folders.hintAppDirectory: Using the app data directory. A "{{subdir}}" folder is created inside it.
folders.hintDefault: Defaults to the app data directory.
folders.hintInside: A "{{subdir}}" folder is created inside this directory.

dialog.title: How do you want to handle existing data?
dialog.description: Data currently lives in the folder you are leaving. This cannot be undone once deleted.
dialog.keep: Keep current data (do not move or delete)
dialog.copy: Copy current data to new location
dialog.delete: Delete current data from old location

behaviour.title: Behaviour
behaviour.streamModeDescription: Hide server addresses in server lists, for example while streaming.
behaviour.systemDotnetDescription: Try your system's .NET runtime before downloading one.
behaviour.showPreReleaseDescription: Include release candidates in the game version pickers.
behaviour.defaultModSortDescription: Sort order used when the mod browser opens.
behaviour.defaultWorldsToActiveProfile: Only show worlds from the active profile
behaviour.defaultWorldsToActiveProfileDescription: The Worlds page starts filtered to the current profile instead of all profiles. You can still change the filter while browsing.
behaviour.promptModInstallDestinationDescription: 1-click install links open the destination picker instead of defaulting to the active profile.

gameDefaults.title: Game defaults
gameDefaults.description: One set of key bindings, game and video settings shared by every profile.
gameDefaults.applyDescription: Applies the source profile's settings to every other profile right before the game starts. Profiles can opt out in their own settings.
gameDefaults.sourceMissing: That profile no longer exists. Choose another one.
gameDefaults.sheetDescription: Applies the chosen profile's current key bindings, game and video settings whenever another profile launches — changes made in the source profile carry over automatically. Mod paths, disabled mods, server lists and entitlements are never copied.
gameDefaults.includeSessionHint: Also copies the signed-in player's name, user id, email and session tokens so the profile stays logged in. A launcher account selected for the launch still takes precedence.

updates.title: Updates
updates.label: Updates
updates.description: Checks quietly; updates are announced in the title bar.

logs.title: Application log
logs.description: Live app output, refreshed every 5 seconds.
logs.privacy: Logs can contain file paths and account names. Review them before sharing.

modStore.title: Shared mod storage
modStore.description: Keep one copy of each mod zip and link it into every profile that uses it. Saves disk space and makes profile copies fast.
modStore.enabledDescription: New mod installs are hardlinked from a central store. Turn off to keep independent copies.
modStore.optimizeHint: Optimize links mods that were installed before this feature or copied by a backup. It skips profiles on another drive.
modStore.pruning: Removing unused mods from the store…
modStore.openFailed: Could not open the store folder: {{message}}
modStore.disabledHint: Shared mod storage is turned off. Enable it first.
